pattern: RAGBench sentence-support row shape restated for this wiki's own labelled set: a response decomposed into sentences, each sentence carrying a support verdict and the keys that support it, scorer outputs kept as separate per-scorer columns, and generator/annotator provenance on every row. SCHEMA ONLY: the external RAGBench dataset is NOT imported - its licence was unverified on the opened page - and no RAGBench rows, code or text are held here.

row.supporting_keys_note: Keys are this wiki's citation keys / page paths (the same keys a compiled claim cites). A supported or partially-supported sentence must name at least one; an unsupported sentence must name none.
row.scorer_columns_note: An object keyed by scorer name; each scorer's verdicts/scores live in its own column object (e.g. {"deterministic": {...}, "judge": {...}}) so scorers are never blended into one number at row level.

provenance_fields.generator: Who/what produced the response: {kind, name} - kind is one of human / model / deterministic-harness, name identifies it.
provenance_fields.annotator: Who/what assigned the support verdicts: {kind, name}, same vocabulary.
